definitions.explanation: A face that shows signs of crying or being about to cry. Can describe someone currently crying or someone whose face shows traces of recent tears.

examples.japanese: {泣|な}き{顔|がお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せないで→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: Don't show me your crying face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{泣|な}き{顔|がお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{胸|むね}が{痛|いた}む→胸が痛む：25565_munegaitamu⟧。
examples.english: It pains my heart to see a child's tearful face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{泣|な}き{顔|がお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: She left the room with tears still on her face.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ (to cry) + ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face), where ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ voices to がお through sequential voicing ({連濁|れんだく}).

USAGE:
Can describe someone actively crying or someone whose face shows traces of recent tears.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {泣|な}き{顔|がお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show a tearful face
- {泣|な}き{顔|がお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get a tearful expression
- {泣|な}き{顔|がお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: with tears still on one's face

RELATED ～{顔|がお} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{笑|え}み→笑み：13768_emi⟧{顔|がお}: smiling face
- {怒|おこ}り{顔|がお}: angry face
- {困|こま}り{顔|がお}: troubled face
- {泣|な}き{顔|がお}: crying face

This ～{顔|がお} pattern is productive and can attach to many verb stems.
